children: Worthington Enterprises entered into a Fifth Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, maintaining a $500 million unsecured revolving credit facility and extending its maturity to August 31, 2031. The facility includes an accordion for up to $300 million in additional commitments or term loans, a $75 million sublimit for letters of credit, and a $50 million swingline. Pricing varies with leverage, and as of closing there were no borrowings or letters of credit outstanding. The company expects the agreement to support liquidity for working capital, capital expenditures, acquisitions and other general corporate purposes.
: Unsecured revolving credit facility (amended and restated)
: PNC Bank as Administrative Agent, with a lender syndicate including JPMorgan Chase Bank and Bank of America
: Extend maturity and enhance liquidity for general purposes
